`vulnetix secrets` runs every built-in rule whose metadata declares `"kind": "secrets"`: 1092 rules at `cli@2449840`. No secret rule declares a language, so each one reads every text file the scan loads. `vulnetix secrets --list-default-rules` prints the built-in table, but it lists rules of every kind, not only these.

| Severity | Rules |
|---|---|
| Critical | 412 |
| High | 520 |
| Medium | 159 |
| Low | 1 |
